en:
I have evidence that points to Kokichi
being the victim! I found *this* in the hangar!
Nyeh! Is that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's coat<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

Yes. And look here—there
are bloodstains on the sleeve.

That would indicate that Kokichi
<CLT=cltSTRONG>suffered an external injury<CLT=cltNORMAL>, correct?
Kokichi was injured?

The fact that these were flushed down the
toilet implies they're evidence of a crime.

...What about it? Kaito's clothes were
in the hydraulic press.

As long as we have that evidence, there's
no doubt that Kaito was the one murdered.

Y-Yeah, that's right... It's one of those
irrefutable evidence thingies.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ever since she found the body in the
hangar, Maki's insisted that it's Kaito's...

<CLT=cltMIND>But why is that? I thought
we had an understanding...

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought...she'd want to
believe Kaito is still alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>Either way, it seems Maki is
hung up on Kaito's clothes.

<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, I need to demonstrate
the flaw in relying on that evidence.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I do that...I think she'll realize.
There's a chance that Kaito is alive.

Actually, there's something bothering me about
the clothes found in the hydraulic press.
Nyeh? What about them?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's something peculiar
about those clothes...
The owner of the clothing

Did those clothes really
belong to Kaito?

We can tell from the sleeve that it's Kaito's
clothes. No one else wore that color.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The sleeve of the jacket
The bloodstain on the clothing
About the bloodstain...

Since Kaito's the victim, that has to be
his blood. What other possibility is there?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Nyeh?
What's the matter?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>There's something peculiar
about those clothes...

Why was <CLT=cltSTRONG>only the sleeve<CLT=cltNORMAL> sticking
out of the hydraulic press?

If Kaito had been crushed by the press,
the sleeve shouldn't have been empty...

There should have been an arm
inside the sleeve as well.

So the fact that we found an empty sleeve
should—
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh!?

You're dumber than I thought if I have to 
go out of my way to explain it to you.

If you can't even see that, then be quiet.
Otherwise, you're just annoying me.
